evolved.criteria.move_forward: Move the gripper 3cm in +x (away from the robot base). Only choose this when the apple is forward of the gripper.
evolved.criteria.move_back: Move the gripper 3cm in -x (back toward the robot base). Only choose this when the apple is behind the gripper.
evolved.criteria.move_left: Move the gripper 3cm in +y (to the left from the base's view). When fingers is "closed", choose open_gripper instead of this.
evolved.criteria.move_right: Move the gripper 3cm in -y (to the right from the base's view). When fingers is "closed", choose ascend instead of this. Only choose this when the apple is to the right of the gripper.
evolved.criteria.descend: Lower the gripper 2.5cm in -z, toward the table. Only choose this when where_the_apple_is_relative_to_the_gripper.along_forward_back_axis is "lined up". Only choose this when where_the_apple_is_relative_to_the_gripper.along_left_right_axis is "lined up".
evolved.criteria.ascend: Raise the gripper 2.5cm in +z, away from the table. Never choose this when gripper_is_held_high_above_the_table is "yes".
evolved.criteria.open_gripper: Open the fingers fully. Releases anything held. Never choose this when fingers_are_gripping_an_object is "yes". Never choose this when fingers is "open".
evolved.criteria.close_gripper: Close the fingers to grip whatever is between them.
evolved.criteria.done: Declare the apple picked up and stop. Never choose this when fingers_are_gripping_an_object is "no".
